lip.plaintext: Look, I'll cut you a break because we're busy here. I'll buzz Therese, tell her you're coming. Take the elevator over there up. But if I hear that you're not supposed to be there, you and me are going to have a little heart to heart, you hear me?

What? Are you serious? I've worked for that bitch for the last fifteen years, and now she's replacing me? Well, you can go take the elevator over there up and tell her she can kiss my ass. I'm outta here...
There's a juice bar down the street. They serve the fruits over there.
Damn. I wish that was my job. Go on up and see her.
Damn. I wish that was my job. Go on up and see her. Take the elevator over there.
What the...what's wrong with your face? They shooting a movie near by or something? Damn, you should really go take off that mask...you're scarin' the clientele.
Like I said, go on up and see Therese. The elevator's over there.
I always hated that damn job, anyway.
Something else you need, chief?
Something else you need, beautiful?
Don't take this the wrong way but...even beer goggles have their limits, you know, if you're hoping to find someone drunk enough to go home with you.
They cut me a check every two weeks. End of discussion.
Oh boy.
Get something for you, chief?
Yeah.
Uh huh.
What can I get you, beautiful?
Right. You going to buy a drink or what?
They ain't here. Therese, I don't know where she went, and Jeanette - she just ran out of here. They'll be back later I guess. Probably havin' lady problems or something.
Knox? Yeah...he's usually around here somewhere. Just look for a guy that doesn't look like he has any business being here. That's Knox.
"Janus? What the hell are you talking about? Damn. Why do I always get the weird ones?"
Janus? What the hell are you talking about? Damn. Why do I always get the weird ones?
Huh? The only sisters around here are Therese and Jeanette, and they own the place. They're both upstairs, fighting as usual. Why do you need to see them?
Wow. I have no idea what you just said. Is she expecting you?
Uh, yeah. Whatever. Look, I'll let you on up, but if you start getting too weird up there I'll come up and put you out of your misery. Undestand?
Uh, yeah. Whatever. Look, I'll let you on up, but if you start getting too weird with Jeanette I'll have to come up and escort your pretty little behind back out on the street. You hear me?
You talkin' about Therese and Jeanette? They cut me a check every two weeks. End of discussion.
You sure? I make a mean Bloody Mary.
Calm down, ace. This isn't that kind of establishment. Get out of line again, and I'll personally introduce your ass to the sidewalk. Now what do you need?
Easy, girl. This ain't that kind of establishment. I'm not one to hit a woman, but you're pushing it. Just tell me what it is that you want.
Lookin' for a good time, huh? Big Cal'll show you a good time. You ain't too hard on the eyes, sweetheart. Me and you, we'll have a little party. I get off around six o'clock.
Yeah. Too bad you ain't going to find out. No offense, but I got beautiful women around me all day, and you just ain't up to snuff. Now can I get you something?
Hey, hey...I guess you mean business. I don't want any trouble. Just tell me what you need.
Therese? She's upstairs. Said she had business to attend to but I can hear her and Jeanette bickering from here. Why do you need to see her?
Yeah, yeah. I hear that from everyone, pal. She expecting you or something?
Yeah, yeah. I hear that from everyone, sweetheart. She expecting you or something?
